context: Makes ReportExporter implement IDisposable and dispose the injected PdfEngine. PdfEngine is registered as a singleton and ReportExporter is created per request.
explanation: PdfEngine is registered once as a singleton and shared by every request. Disposing it from ReportExporter.Dispose(), which runs at the end of a single scoped/transient request, tears down that shared engine for the entire application the moment any one request finishes and its ReportExporter is released — every other in-flight and future request then hits ObjectDisposedException. Fix: do not dispose services you do not own; only the code that registered/created a singleton should ever dispose it.
